Job Title: Software Developer 
 
Job Category: Information Technology 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: None 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 
 The Opportunity: 
 We are seeking a motivated and highly responsive Software Developer who is committed to delivering critical software solutions in support of the Department of the Navy (DoN) mission. Join our Agile team supporting customer and application needs across multiple efforts for our Navy customer deployed in unclassified and classified production environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and Government customers to design, build, and deliver innovative features while supporting modernization initiatives, identifying opportunities for artificial intelligence (AI) applications, developing software, and maintaining audit compliance.
 Responsibilities: 
 ·         Define and implement project deliverables throughout the software development life cycle.
 ·         Update front-end code using Java, Python, and JavaScript, as well as back-end code and Oracle databases, for applications.
 ·         Apply secure coding best practices to help protect each application.
 ·         Design, develop, and implement software modifications in response to system change requests.
 ·         Implement software enhancements and add new functionality based on Government-directed requirements.
 ·         Troubleshoot system software defects and develop effective solutions.
 ·         Analyze system database performance and recommend and implement improvements.
 ·         Mitigate software security vulnerabilities to support cybersecurity compliance.
 ·         Support the application release pipeline in development environments.
 ·         Use Jira to track code and database changes within an Agile Scrum process.
 ·         Research AI, data structures, and algorithms using a variety of tools, technologies, methodologies, and data analysis techniques to improve existing AI models and develop innovative solutions.
 ·         Analyze current system architecture and propose upgrades as new technological advances become available.
 ·         Coordinate with stakeholders to support compliance with financial and information technology audit standards for operations and systems.
  
 Qualifications: 
 Required: 
 ·         Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
 ·         Five or more years of experience with Java, Python, or similar programming languages and/or experience writing PL/SQL code.
 ·         Experience with current AWS AI services, modern AI frameworks, and AI considerations—including security, privacy, and regulatory requirements—for developing and deploying AI features.
 ·         Ability to solve problems and troubleshoot effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 ·         Willing and able to support off-hours and weekend coverage as needed.
 ·         Experience defining and designing complex requirements.
 ·         Willing and able to obtain an Interim/Secret clearance. Current and active Secret preferred
 ·         Willing and able to work a hybrid schedule with 1-2 days per week onsite in Washington, DC.
  
 Desired: 
 ·         Experience with AWS RDS for Oracle.
 ·         Strong database development experience.
 ·         Experience with Python frameworks such as Django.
 ·         Experience with Agile methodologies, including Jira.
 ·         Experience supporting the Department of Defense or other Federal agencies.
 ·         Experience with Department of Defense Financial and Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) data and processes.
 ·         Security+ certification.
 ·         Excellent planning, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to work with minimal supervision.
 ·         Strong written and verbal communication, analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills.
 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$86,600 - $181,800 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
